description:
Daily APY and TVL history for one market, with min, median, max and volatility over the window.

Use this for one question only: has this rate held, or did it appear yesterday? Call it before acting on any unusually high rate.

Use something else when: you want the other risk factors — fee, size, utilisation, concentration — which are in `market_profile`; you are still choosing a market (`list_base_yields` or `best_yield`).

Prerequisite: a market id from one of the list tools. Check `observations` before concluding anything — a market added recently has few snapshots, and a short series is not evidence of stability.

pool.description: Market id: the `pool` field from list_base_yields, or 'vault:<address>' using an address from list_lending_vaults, e.g. 'vault:0x7bfa7c4f149e7415b73bdedfe609237e29cbf34a'

name: yield_history
title: Has this rate held?
